panels.title: k6 function stress — where this data comes from

panels.description: This dashboard renders the k6 function stress suite (ops/loadtest, `npm run stress:suite`). Panels show "No data" until the operator exports k6 results to Prometheus with `k6 run --out experimental-prometheus-rw=$PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE_URL`. That is an operator decision — a remote-write endpoint is a write credential for the monitoring host — so nothing in this repository enables it, exactly as documented in ops/monitoring/README.md under "What the stack does NOT do". A panel with no data therefore means the export is not configured, not that the platform was never stressed.

options.content:
The suite is the source of truth for coverage (config/stress-budget.json) and for the budgets it enforces. Run it against a live API and export to Prometheus to make these panels live.

  K6_PROMETHEUS_RW_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9090/api/v1/write k6 run --out experimental-prometheus-rw=$K6_PROMETHEUS_RW_URL ops/loadtest/k6/functions-stress.js

Schema (see ops/loadtest/README.md): config/stress-budget.json → scripts/run-k6-stress-suite.mjs → ops/loadtest/k6/functions-stress.js.
